others.name: Uplift Champion Ninetysix limited
others.role: Shareholder owned by Ching Hei Chan

what: It provides temperature-controlled trucking and warehouse services to customers in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $21.6 million. About 40% is for buying logistics and warehousing firms, 30% for more handling capacity and 20% for warehousing technology. The rest is for running costs and working capital.
risks: New U.S. rules could bar the shares from trading if its auditor cannot be inspected by U.S. regulators for two years in a row.
Cash and assets held in Hong Kong may be hard to move out of Hong Kong if restrictions are imposed.
Shareholders may not be able to enforce court judgments they win against the company.
Its managers have no experience running a U.S. public company or following the laws that apply to one.
It is a holding company, so its ability to pay dividends depends on payouts from its Hong Kong subsidiary.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
